title: PH, Vietnam seek improved maritime affairs cooperation
summary: President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. on Thursday met with Vietnamese President To Lam on the sidelines of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting to advance cooperation in maritime affairs.

blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. on Thursday met with Vietnamese President To Lam on the sidelines of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting to advance cooperation in maritime affairs.
Marcos and To, who are both in Shenzhen, China for the APEC summit, also discussed matters on food security, according to the Presidential Communications Office (PCO).
The PCO said Marcos also conveyed the Philippines' full support for Vietnam's hosting of APEC in 2027.
This year, China is the host country for the high-level economic forum.
The two leaders likewise reaffirmed both countries' commitment to regional cooperation and shared prosperity, the PCO said. — VDV, GMA News
